description: Source code for spawn control entities in the Unvanquished game, including relay and limited control mechanisms.

methods.name: target_relay_act
methods.description: Handles activation of relay entities, firing events or delaying based on spawn flags.

methods.name: ctrl_relay_reset
methods.description: Resets relay entity enabled state based on spawn flags.

methods.name: ctrl_relay_act
methods.description: Handles activation of relay entities, firing events immediately or with delay.

methods.name: SP_ctrl_relay
methods.description: Initializes relay entities, setting activation and reset functions.

methods.name: ctrl_limited_act
methods.description: Handles limited control entity activation, firing and decrementing count.

methods.name: ctrl_limited_reset
methods.description: Resets limited control entity state and count.

methods.name: SP_ctrl_limited
methods.description: Initializes limited control entities, setting activation and reset functions.
